correctness.rationale: The uniform deletion-link proof identifies B with a p-fold S^0 join and L with S^0, then a nullhomotopic attaching map gives an integral S^1 wedge S^{p-1}. Long exact sequences give S_p characters. Pole-reversal orientation on the cross-polytope top class and one invariant edge Lefschetz trace force the remaining integral eigenvalue -1. All p>=3 quantifiers, p=2 boundary and lack of equivariant wedge splitting are explicit. check.py rebuilds face and signed-trace data, with modulo-two homology verification for p=3..5 and all elements for p=3..6.

value.rationale: The all-p natural theta family has the full automorphism group S_p x C2. Its two reduced integral homology lines have distinct characters, yielding a precise parity transition under pole reversal; ranks and ordinary sphere wedge types alone cannot reveal these signs. Even-p members are canonical double covers of friendship graphs and therefore a natural input in the 2026 Mycielskian framework. This is a motivated complete integral representation classification, not a parameter-free renaming, arbitrary narrow slice, or numerical increment.
